items.title: (PR) ASUS Announces Availability of the ProArt GR1X
items.summary: ASUS today announced the availability of the ProArt GR1X mini PC. Built on the NVIDIA RTX Spark superchip, ProArt GR1X is a Windows PC designed as an always-on home for local AI agents. ProArt GR1X can be specified with 128 GB and 64 GB of unified memory.
